'''Kryndyn spaceport''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kryndyn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zelos II]]. The [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] [[Diergu-Rea Duhnes'rd]] and [[Solum'ke]] set out from Kryndyn [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in search of [[Zelosian's Chine]].<ref name="Sepulchral">{{JournalCite|13|Day of the Sepulchral Night (short story)}}</ref>
